personal.preferred_title: Dynatrace / APM Observability Engineer | Dashboards, KPIs, RCA & Production Support

summary: Senior observability, APM, telemetry, and production support professional with 20+ years of enterprise experience across Dynatrace AppMon/Synthetics, CA APM/Introscope, AppDynamics, BMC TrueSight/TSCO, dashboarding, KPIs, incident support, RCA, performance troubleshooting, Python/shell scripting, SQL, and infrastructure/application telemetry analysis. Strong background translating monitoring data into actionable operational insights, designing dashboard and alert standards, supporting production troubleshooting, and communicating application/infrastructure health to technical and leadership stakeholders. Best aligned to Dynatrace/APM observability roles requiring dashboard creation, KPI reporting, telemetry analysis, proactive monitoring, L3/SRE-style production support, RCA, and Python/shell automation; Splunk dashboards/searches/visualizations are positioned carefully as adjacent or learning areas unless confirmed hands-on.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Supported enterprise observability, capacity, and production reliability workflows across BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, AppDynamics, Oracle, AWS-backed reporting layers, and large-scale infrastructure telemetry feeds.
Built Python/Pandas/PySpark and SQL workflows that processed telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints into validated dashboards, KPI reports, capacity forecasts, and operational insights.

Analyzed infrastructure and application health signals including utilization trends, latency symptoms, missing feeds, abnormal metric movement, and reporting discrepancies to support RCA and reliability decisions.
Developed validation checks for telemetry freshness, row counts, missing data, unmatched records, abnormal deltas, and output consistency to improve trust in monitoring and reporting views.
Troubleshot production issues by tracing source feeds, metric behavior, Python processing, SQL transformations, failed outputs, latency symptoms, and downstream dashboard/reporting discrepancies.
Created runbooks, metric definitions, dashboard notes, validation checkpoints, support procedures, and troubleshooting documentation to improve repeatable operational response.
Partnered with infrastructure, application, analytics, engineering, and business teams to explain telemetry findings, coordinate fixes, and improve production reliability.
Used Python, SQL, Unix/Linux-style scripting patterns, AWS concepts, and monitoring data to support repeatable observability reporting and operational insight workflows.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems, improving visibility into application performance and user-facing reliability.
Designed and maintained Dynatrace dashboards and monitoring views for application performance, synthetic transaction behavior, infrastructure health signals, and operational insight.
Correlated real-user monitoring, synthetic transaction data, and load-test behavior to identify bottlenecks, user-impacting symptoms, and improvement opportunities.
Led the FAST project, mining real-user and synthetic monitoring telemetry to surface optimization recommendations adopted by engineering teams.
Created dashboards and reporting views that converted raw monitoring signals into actionable performance, reliability, and stakeholder insights.
Collaborated with application and infrastructure teams to validate findings, document issues, and support practical performance and reliability improvements.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Served as CA APM/Introscope SME for a large financial-services environment with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents.
Defined monitoring standards, dashboards, alert rules, SLA thresholds, validation checks, and operational reporting artifacts for application, middleware, infrastructure, and operations teams.
Provided production troubleshooting guidance using CA APM telemetry, transaction visibility, dashboards, alerts, J2EE/WebLogic monitoring, and performance-analysis patterns.
Built Perl and KornShell automation for extracting, validating, transforming, and distributing APM telemetry, replacing manual reporting workflows with repeatable observability processes.
Delivered onboarding support, training material, technical documentation, and knowledge sharing to improve adoption of monitoring and troubleshooting practices.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Analyzed J2EE telecom applications under load to identify throughput limits, JDBC bottlenecks, thread contention, heap pressure, CPU constraints, memory issues, and garbage-collection symptoms.
Configured JMX Monitoring, Wily Introscope, and thread-dump automation scripts to improve runtime visibility during performance and production-readiness testing.
Documented performance baselines, defects, risks, telemetry findings, and remediation recommendations for engineering and release teams.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led validation and production-readiness support for a high-throughput shopping engine migration from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster.
Built C++/OCCI/OCI validation and regression testing utilities to verify correctness across millions of migrated transaction records.
Optimized SQL and Oracle access patterns for high-volume workloads while reducing physical hardware footprint by 95%.

experience.title: Architect / Developer (IRS CADE Project)
bullets: Designed UML class and sequence diagrams and developed modules for IRS CADE mainframe modernization.
Built CICS, MQ Series, XML messaging interfaces, VC++ components, and DB2-backed integration modules in a government modernization environment.

experience.title: Developer / Support Engineer (Billing, Interfaces, CSM/PRMS)
bullets: Developed and supported billing, customer-management, and operational interfaces using C, C++, Pro*C, Oracle, PL/SQL, SQL scripts, XML, Java/J2EE concepts, and enterprise messaging patterns.
Built automation scripts in KornShell/ksh, Perl, Awk, Syncsort, and SQL to support extraction, transformation, reporting, deployments, validation, and production housekeeping.
Provided production support, defect investigation, troubleshooting, issue escalation, release support, and QA-cycle coordination for telecom billing and customer-management applications.
